name: memory
description: Persistent key-value memory store with tags and search. Supports store, recall, search, update, delete operations via JSON messages.

default_subscriptions.description: Store a key-value entry. Payload: {key, value, tags?}.
Recall an entry by exact key. Payload: {key}.
Search entries by free-text matching against keys, values, and tags. Payload: {query}.
Update an existing entry's value or tags. Payload: {key, value?, tags?}.
Delete an entry by key. Payload: {key}.
List all entries, optionally filtered by tag. Payload: {tag?}.
